note: Each case is run as: verifyAttestationL3(attestation, { keys: trusted_keys, journal, trustedHeads?, scope? }) or the CLI equivalent (authority proof verify <attestation> --keys <trusted_keys> --journal <journal> [--trusted-heads <file>] [--scope prefix] --json). 'anchored' says only that a supplied anchor matches and covers the attested prefix; it never says the anchor is independent.

cases.name: redemption-replays
cases.description: Genuine redemption against its journal: CONSISTENT_L3, NOT anchored (nothing ties the journal to the signer's system).

cases.name: redemption-anchored
cases.description: With an anchor the verifier supplied that covers the attested prefix: anchored. Independence of the anchor is never established by the tool.

cases.name: anchor-below-attested-head
cases.description: An anchor that matches but is earlier than the attested head covers only part of it: not anchored.

cases.name: longer-journal-valid-suffix
cases.description: A longer valid journal with the same prefix: CONSISTENT_L3; the later revocation is listed for information only.

cases.name: invalid-suffix-full-scope
cases.description: The attested prefix is sound but the journal provided does not replay after it: refused under the default (full) scope.

cases.name: invalid-suffix-prefix-scope
cases.description: The same journal under the explicit prefix-only scope: the suffix is NOT validated and the report says so.

cases.name: truncated-journal
cases.description: A journal shorter than the attested head.

cases.name: reordered-journal
cases.description: Two events swapped: does not replay.

cases.name: divergent-journal-same-length
cases.description: Another valid history of the same length: internally consistent, but not the journal this attests.

cases.name: anchor-wrong-hash
cases.description: The verifier's anchor does not match the journal: divergent or rewritten.

cases.name: anchor-beyond-journal
cases.description: The verifier's anchor is beyond the journal's length: truncated relative to the anchor.

cases.name: revoked-key-always
cases.description: The key is revoked ALWAYS: REJECTED at L1 even though the statement matches the journal and an anchor covers it. L3 is not run.

cases.name: validly-signed-lie-refused-by-replay
cases.description: A signed statement with a head no journal supports passes L1 and L2 but is refused by the deterministic replay.
